resources.string: Set up game data
1. Prepare your game files

You need your own installed copies of Command & Conquer: Generals AND Zero Hour. Copy the complete game folders to this device, for example Download/GeneralsZH. No game purchase or download is included. The app uses these files where they are; it does not duplicate the full game.
Steam or CD / ISO: which files?

Steam: install Zero Hour on your computer and copy its complete installation folder. Keep ZH_Generals inside it if present. If Generals is installed separately, copy that folder too.

CD / ISO: first install or fully extract both games on your computer. Copy the resulting installed game folders, not just the disc image or setup files. A raw ISO, setup.exe, MSI or CAB is not a playable game folder. This app does not run Windows installers or mount disc images.

Zero Hour contains INIZH.big, TexturesZH.big and W3DZH.big. The base game contains INI.big, Terrain.big, Textures.big and W3D.big, plus audio, maps and other archives. Keep the complete folder contents, including Data and videos. Do not rename or unpack the .big archives.

Merged folders, ZH_Generals subfolders and separate Generals folders are supported. Selecting a parent searches up to two folder levels; if several installations are found, choose the intended game folder.

Your originals stay in place. After confirmation, the app adds runtime configuration, fonts and its Window overrides to the selected game folder. Game text and speech depend on the language files you own.
2. Select the installed game folders

Choose Zero Hour first. A contained or adjacent Generals folder is detected automatically when unambiguous. Otherwise choose the base game separately. Your previous configuration stays active until a complete set is confirmed.
Choose Zero Hour folder
